answer: Sybil resistance via bonded attestation quorums: a seat exists only while it keeps a marble of POA bonded, and each attestation it signs needs two co-signers who share any slash. To island N identities an operator must bond N stakes and staff N independent signing slots, since duplicate keys from one host expose shared co-signers and trigger a anchor cascade burning their bonds. Cost per fake seat then exceeds its expected reward, keeping honest single-owner seats viable.
